experiment_data.hypothesis: DC-GRPO with cosine similarity R1 (replacing tanh(dot/20) which saturated due to activation norms 100-1200x across layers). Cosine R1 ∈ [-1,1] is norm-invariant, giving equal weight to all reward layers. Same config as exp-002 (R1=0.25, R3=0.75, R2=0, LoRA r=64, 8000 steps). If cosine R1 shows stable training signal (no ±1 oscillation) and improves sycophancy reduction over R3-only (exp-003), this validates the direction-projection mechanism with proper normalization.
